# codeframe-lib

**codeframe-lib** is the official reusable utility and foundation library shipped with every project generated by [CodeFrame](https://github.com/XtremeStudios/CodeFrame). It encapsulates consistent logic, patterns, and tools used across all XtremeStudios applications.

## ✨ Features

- 🧱 Core utilities for strings, arrays, objects, types, and async flows
- ⚙️ Shared configuration and type systems
- 🔧 Engineered to plug directly into any CodeFrame-generated project
- 📦 Lightweight, dependency-free (XPM-compatible)
- 🧠 Clean, composable, and built for scale
